main.title: CPU Integration and Verification
main.speaker: A
main.goal: Identify the integrated design and the five parts of this presentation.
main.speech: We present a sixteen-bit, five-stage CPU integrated and verified on EES-331.
main.cue: 开场直接对应老师要求。版本为CPU v1.6、ISA v1.5、默认AC1。

main.title: Contents
main.speaker: A
main.speech: We will cover the ISA, design process, architecture and execution, functional evidence, and performance trade-offs.
main.cue: 按六章目录指明主线；目录页只讲路线，不提前展开模块。
main.goal: Provide the numbered chapter structure and page ranges.

main.title: 1.1 Instruction encoding
main.speaker: A
main.goal: Present every opcode and the complete instruction field layout.
main.speech: Every instruction occupies sixteen bits. The fields contain a four-bit opcode, two register fields, and an eight-bit immediate or displacement. This is the complete ISA encoding, including the reserved opcodes. AND and OR use two and three; loads and stores use eight and nine. Each instruction defines how its register fields are used. All four registers are writable.
main.cue: 展示完整16项编码，讲分组，不逐格念。Rd字段在CMP/STR等形式中的角色要分清。

main.title: 1.2 Operands and state updates
main.speaker: A
main.goal: Explain source roles and all architectural write permissions.
main.speech: These rules determine our datapath. Register arithmetic reads both fields. Immediate MOV uses an extended constant. A store reads its base from Rs and its data from Rd. Constants and absolute jumps use zero extension; memory and relative-branch offsets use sign extension. ADD and SUB update carry and overflow, while CMP updates Z. The remaining instructions preserve these flags.
main.cue: 真实源、写入目标和Z/C/V规则；C为进位或减法无借位。下一页将这些规则连接到设计流程。

main.title: 2.1 Constraints, decisions and design order
main.speaker: A
main.goal: Connect the engineering decisions in their dependency order.
main.speech: This table links constraints to engineering decisions. Synchronous memories led us to align their registered outputs with the decode and writeback boundaries. Register dependencies led to forwarding and bypass. Load latency required a one-cycle interlock. Branches and stopping events required age-based arbitration. The design order runs from ISA and interfaces through timing, control, integration, and verification. B will now show how these decisions form the hardware.
main.cue: 按约束—决策—结果讲两三个关键取舍，底部指设计先后顺序，末句交接B。

main.title: 3.1 Overall CPU architecture
main.speaker: B
main.goal: Show the full control, datapath, memories and feedback connections.
main.speech: The complete architecture has control above the five-stage datapath, with synchronous instruction and data memories outside the core. Control combines global mode, traveling instruction intentions, and cross-stage decisions. The lower feedback paths return the information needed for those decisions.
main.cue: 这是完整总图；沿上下层指出CU、DP、外部IM/DM。细节在后续页放大，不逐线念。

main.title: 3.1.1 Five-stage datapath
main.speaker: B
main.goal: Retain all functional paths and the four existing pipeline boundaries.
main.speech: The four pipeline boundaries keep instruction data, control, and valid tags aligned. Notice the two memory outputs. Registered IM data supplies the decode boundary, and registered DM data supplies the load value in writeback. This arrangement implements the one-cycle memory contract within five pipeline stages. Each stage carries the same instruction's remaining information forward.
main.cue: 完整图保留前递、Z选择、目标计算和RF/flags回路。强调同步IM/DM输出承担边界。

main.title: 3.1.2 Forwarding and branch paths
main.speaker: B
main.goal: Trace register, store, branch and writeback paths in the detailed design.
main.speech: Follow the forwarding paths first. Execute selects the newest ready Rd and Rs values before the ALU input multiplexers choose the operands. Loads and stores use Rs plus the signed displacement; store data follows its separate Rd path. The comparison and branch-target paths are also separate. A JZ selects the newest qualified CMP result, and an accepted redirect returns its target to the PC.
main.cue: 放大原完整datapath中ID/EX至WB部分。分开指STR基址与数据、目标地址与Z条件。

main.title: 3.2 System integration and interfaces
main.speaker: B
main.goal: Connect the complete system diagram to every original execution port.
main.speech: The system connects the core to separate instruction and data memories. Each holds two hundred and fifty-six sixteen-bit words. The interface table shows the requests, returned data, and access qualifiers. The core checks the full effective address before selecting a physical memory location. File initialization supplies the starting program and data; committed data memory is retained across a core reset.
main.cue: 左完整系统图，右完整原执行接口表。同步读一拍、store只写一次、reset不重载DM。

main.title: 3.2.1 EES-331 board integration
main.speaker: B
main.goal: Explain the complete clock, reset, VIO and observation connections.
main.speech: The EES-331 layer adds clock buffering, synchronized reset release, counters, LEDs, and VIO. The clock enters at M19; S1 is the active-low request at L18. VIO observes a register writeback shadow and the state and performance probes. Its reset output controls program startup. C will now explain how the controller coordinates execution.
main.cue: 完整板级图。RF读数是写回影子；VIO reset是控制输入，不能说整个VIO完全只读。交接C。

main.title: 3.3 Pipeline control
main.speaker: C
main.goal: Explain global mode, traveling control fields and qualified stage actions.
main.speech: Control operates at three levels. Global mode handles running, draining, and stopping. Cross-stage logic evaluates dependencies, readiness, and instruction age. Local stage logic combines the traveling instruction intention with its current eligibility. For example, decode creates a register-write intention. That intention travels with the instruction; at writeback, a valid, fault-free slot produces the actual rf_we enable. This is how control stays attached to the correct data and token.
main.cue: 指完整CU放大图：FSM与跨级仲裁在上，各级资格在下。CW_X/M/W不是额外寄存器或五个FSM。

main.title: 3.3.1 Operating modes and priority
main.speaker: C
main.goal: Show the complete five-mode transition graph and qualified priority order.
main.speech: The five modes describe global operation. During RUN, different instructions occupy IF through WB concurrently. An accepted HALT or instruction fault starts the corresponding drain mode. The stop token reaches writeback before the final stopped mode. Reset restarts operation. Event arbitration follows instruction age: an older MEM fault suppresses a younger EX event while eligible older writeback completes.
main.cue: 五状态是整机运行模式，不是IF到WB串行状态。MEM故障优先于年轻EX事件，不能把不可能并发的事件硬画成状态转移。

main.title: 3.3.2 Dependencies and resolution
main.speaker: C
main.goal: Show forwarding, bypass, interlock, flag selection and false-source exclusion.
main.speech: Readiness determines the mechanism. Ready M and W values forward to execute, and WB-to-ID bypass handles a simultaneous read and write. A matching unready load blocks the older same-register value. The true consumer therefore waits one cycle, then receives the new value. The network checks both source roles independently, including store base and data. JZ uses its separate newest-Z selection path.
main.cue: 完整矩阵包含数据、标志、控制和资源；R0可写，Rd=Rs两路独立检查。Harvard排除IF/MEM争用，顺序流水排除WAR/WAW。

main.title: 3.3.3 Load-to-store execution
main.speaker: C
main.goal: Explain the real eight-cycle trace and exactly one memory write.
main.speech: This case checks one load-use hold and one memory write. In cycle three, the load executes while the store waits in decode. Cycle four contains the execute bubble. Writeback forwards the loaded seven in cycle five. The store writes memory in six and keeps its writeback tag in seven. HALT completes in eight. A ready ALU result instead forwards without this hold. D will now explain branch and stopping behavior.
main.cue: 按真实C3保持/C4 bubble/C5 W前递/C6唯一DM写/C7 STR标签/C8HALT讲。初态来自TB预置。交接D。

main.title: 3.3.4 Branch and cancellation
main.speaker: D
main.goal: Explain the real nine-cycle branch trace and cancelled store.
main.speech: When JZ enters execute, the preceding CMP is in MEM and supplies its equality candidate. Cycle four redirects to PC three and cancels the younger store. The branch continues through the pipeline, and the target HALT completes in cycle nine. The trace checks the branch decision and confirms that the wrong-path store produces no memory write.
main.cue: C4 M.CMP对X.JZ前递Z，D.STR取消；目标HALT在C9完成。

main.title: 3.3.5 Precise HALT and fault handling
main.speaker: D
main.goal: Distinguish a real instruction, a bubble, a held slot and a cancelled slot.
main.speech: These two cases check completion by instruction age. Above, the older store writes in cycle four and retires before HALT stops the CPU at six. Below, cycle six combines an older ADD writeback, a memory-stage address fault, and a younger jump. The ADD completes, while the invalid access and jump are suppressed. The fault token reaches writeback and the CPU reports FAULTED at seven.
main.cue: 上下两个真实案例。CaseA: C4 store/C5 STR WB/C6 HALT。CaseB: C6老ADD写回与M.LDR越界同拍，年轻JUMP取消；C7 FAULTED。不是下一拍才让老WB完成。

main.title: 4.1 Verification strategy
main.speaker: D
main.goal: Connect ISA expectations, per-edge assertions and integrated verification layers.
main.speech: The ISA model supplies expected register, flag, store, and stopping behavior. Directed vectors check boundary values. Testbenches compare each qualified event and the final state. Module, independent, and integration suites exercise complementary layers. The next two pages follow actual programs through those checks, linking expected results to simulation and board observations.
main.cue: 分层展示已有回归与本次新运行；21项主机/文档检查不是实板功能测试。

main.title: 4.2 Baseline: program to waveform
main.speaker: D
main.goal: Show sampled events from the delivered project and its executable entry.
main.speech: In baseline, PCs five to seven form a store, load, and dependent compare. Cycle nine shows the older store proceeding while the front end holds. CMP sets Z, so JZ skips the next MOV. We expect R0 and R2 to equal eight, R1 to remain two, and seventeen cycles. The actual XSim trace and checker match these predictions.
main.cue: 左侧baseline实际指令05–07对应C9同时stall/store，08 JZ对应C12 redirect；右侧期望与实际RF/flags/C=17对齐。

main.title: 4.3 Checksum: model to board
main.speaker: D
main.goal: Present all five archived physical outcomes and the raw reset sequence.
main.speech: The five board programs reached their expected stopping states and counts. For checksum, the model predicts R1 equal to hexadecimal one two three two, zero flags, HALT at PC zero zero two two, and fifty-five cycles. VIO reports the same values. The physical S1 sequence clears the state and then restarts the program to the same result. E will explain the performance costs.
main.cue: 先讲checksum预期与VIO实测对账，再指S1重启；raw state256/perf160仅在备注。平台图若使用手册图片，明确它是平台示意而非本次测试照片。

main.title: 5.1 Counters and cycle model
main.speaker: E
main.goal: Define the physical counters and the domain of the cycle equation.
main.speech: We count completed instructions N, load-use stalls S, and accepted redirects R. For these normal-HALT programs, total cycles equal N plus four plus S plus twice R. N includes HALT. Four accounts for pipeline filling and completion, and every accepted redirect adds two cycles. CPI is the total cycles divided by N.
main.cue: 先定义N、S、R、C和CPI，再展示数值。不要把公式推广到故障或任意复位epoch。

main.title: 5.2 Measured cycles and CPI
main.speaker: E
main.goal: Explain the complete five-program cycle breakdown and avoid workload ranking.
main.speech: The bars separate instructions from overhead. Baseline is ten plus four plus one plus two: seventeen cycles. Loop's four redirects add eight cycles. Checksum is thirty-five plus four plus sixteen: fifty-five. Its CPI is one point five seven, below baseline's one point seven zero, because more instructions spread the fixed overhead. These bars explain each workload. Comparing the same program under matched conditions measures a design improvement.
main.cue: 按堆叠颜色讲N/4/S/2R，重点loop与checksum；总周期不能跨工作量排名。

main.title: 5.3 FPGA mapping and timing
main.speaker: E
main.goal: Show all five implementation results with their correct top-level scope.
main.speech: All five routed board implementations achieve positive setup and hold slack under the ten-nanosecond constraint. Each uses two BRAM18 blocks. The table gives complete board-top resources, including memories and VIO. These results confirm the timing target for the integrated design.
main.cue: 完整资源和setup/hold表回到正文；LUT total含LUTRAM，WNS/WHS单位ns。

main.title: 5.4 Optimization trade-offs
main.speaker: E
main.goal: Account for both completed offline candidates without changing the accepted design.
main.speech: WB-to-MEM forwarding cuts checksum from fifty-five to forty-seven cycles: fourteen point five percent fewer cycles, at eighty-six extra LUTs and two flip-flops. It removes store-data dependencies; a load feeding the store base still requires a hold. AC1 is our board-verified release, and the candidate is a quantified upgrade. The separate forwarding-MUX experiment provided no cycle benefit.
main.cue: checksum 55→47为减少14.5%周期、同频1.17倍；不是14.5%速度提升。+86 LUT为含VIO整机增量，不能叫核心逻辑增加7.8%。

main.title: 6.1 Deliverables
main.speaker: E
main.goal: Close the assignment with the actual runnable files and design document.
main.speech: We delivered the ISA, integrated datapath and control, functional evidence, and performance analysis. The course folder contains the specification, presentation, group script, and two ready-to-use Vivado project entries. Thank you.
main.cue: 收束到老师四项要求与常用目录的真实工程文件。演示可选，不自动连接硬件。

questions: Why do five pipeline stages not mean five global execution states?
RUN can persist while different instructions occupy all five stages. The global modes describe running, draining and stopping. Local actions depend on each slot and cross-stage decisions.
What is the difference between a control intention and an enable?
Decode creates an intention such as reg_write. Validity, fault status, reset and mode qualify it at the action stage. rf_we is the resulting writeback enable.
Why does load-to-store need a stall in default AC1?

Both store operands are prepared in EX. An adjacent load returns data only at the end of MEM. The store waits one cycle, then forwards ready W data into EX. The WB-to-MEM candidate uses a different contract.
Why does output reg not necessarily imply flip-flops?

A fully assigned combinational always block describes combinational logic. The Verilog variable type permits procedural assignment. State requires clocked storage or incomplete combinational assignment.
What do carry and overflow mean?
For ADD, C is the unsigned carry out. For SUB, C means no borrow. V detects signed overflow. ADD and SUB update C/V, CMP updates Z, and memory-address arithmetic preserves architectural flags.
Where do LDR, STR and CMP calculate their results?
LDR and STR use the ALU for base plus signed displacement, preserving flags. CMP uses the independent equality path on forwarded operands and writes Z in WB.
Why does CMP-to-JZ need no register data stall?
JZ selects the newest eligible CMP Z candidate from M, then W, then saved Z. CMP still updates architectural Z at WB. The branch uses the candidate as a condition.
How does synchronous memory avoid adding a sixth stage?

The registered IM output is the ID instruction data boundary. The registered DM output supplies the WB load value. The existing tag registers align with those outputs. No extra IR or MDR is cascaded there.
How independent is the reference model?

It implements ISA effects separately from pipeline control and is cross-checked against explicit boundary vectors. Timing assertions check implementation-specific events separately. Shared specification errors remain possible, so finite passing tests are not a full proof.
What exactly did the board verify?

Five normal-HALT programs, each with two stable VIO snapshots, plus physical S1 reset/restart after stopping. RF observations are writeback shadows. Fault paths and internal cycle traces retain their simulation evidence.
Why can a longer program have a lower CPI?
Fixed filling overhead is amortized across more completed instructions, and instruction mixes incur different stalls and redirects. Compare the work and overhead, not total cycles alone.
Is the CPU execution time directly measured?
Cycle counters are physically observed. Converting them to nanoseconds assumes the designed 100 MHz clock. Independent frequency, wall-time and power measurements were not performed.
